L1.en: 2 a.m. Someone wants what's on your Mac.
L1.id: Jam dua pagi. Ada yang mengincar isi Mac kamu.

L4.en: But there's nothing here. No history. No logins. No chats.
L4.id: Tapi isinya kosong. Tanpa riwayat. Tanpa login. Tanpa chat.

L6.en: Because hours earlier, you logged out. And your Mac forgot everything.
L6.id: Karena beberapa jam sebelumnya, kamu logout. Dan Mac kamu lupa semuanya.

L8.en: Amnesia. Free on GitHub. Forget everything.
L8.id: Amnesia. Gratis di GitHub. Lupakan semuanya.

O1.en: Uh-oh. Your parents want your Mac password.

O2.en: No sweat. Save and log out.

O3.en: Apps and private stuff go into the vault.

O4.en: They log in. A clean Mac. Just your homework.

B1.en: A friend wants to borrow your Mac.

B2.en: Your whole life is on it. Chats. Tabs. Photos.

B3.en: Save and log out. Your stuff goes into the vault.

B4.en: Log back in. A clean Mac. Hand it over.

B5.en: Got it back? One click, and it's all yours again.

B6.en: Amnesia. Lend your Mac, not your life.
